acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass explains how things have changed in Hong Kong this month, and wonders how things are going for a protester we’re calling Jennifer, who he went to protests with back in the fall. We start with what her life was like in September.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A bunch of 22-year-olds from Hong Kong explain why they are cursed and what that means for their and Hong Kong’s future.
acts.title: Cursed Generation

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Jennifer, Ira, and producer Emanuele Berry go to a protest and get tear gassed in front of a Ruth's Chris Steakhouse.
acts.title: The Fight

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: A protestor who thinks the Hong Kong police are terrible has a chat with his dad — a police officer. Alan Yu reports.
acts.title: Good Cop, Dad Cop

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Producer Diane Wu goes to a party. A Chinese flag party.
acts.title: A Slow Boat to China

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass calls Jennifer to talk about the new security law.
acts.title: Nine Months Later
